'''Sheris''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Belsmuth sector/Legends|Belsmuth sector]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was under the control of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], while a few [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Engagement at Sheris|defeated]] a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] there. As part of Imperial [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], an Imperial [[Imperial Military/Legends|force]] advanced on Sheris, leading to a [[Stand at Bhir'khi Pass|battle]] in the planet's [[Bhir'khi Pass]].

==Description==
Sheris was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Journal9" /> located in the [[Sheris system/Legends|Sheris system]], a part of the [[Belsmuth sector/Legends|Belsmuth sector]]<ref name="EAOC Sheris" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC Sheris" /> The [[Salin Corridor/Legends|Salin Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] linked it to the [[Belsmuth system/Legends|Belsmuth]], [[Botajef system/Legends|Botajef]], [[Katraasii system/Legends|Katraasii]], [[New Bornalex system/Legends|New Bornalex]], and [[Shadren system/Legends|Shadren systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> The planet's surface featured a number of continents and [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]], with the [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]] in the mountains in the vicinity of the [[Marter An]] [[City/Legends|city]] being [[Temperature/Legends|cold]]. A valley in Sheris' [[Bhir'khi Pass]] featured light [[Plant/Legends|vegetation]].<ref name="Journal9" />

==History==
===Powers in transit===
[[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a receding glacier deposited a number of [[Stone/Legends|boulders]] several [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall in a valley of Sheris' Bhir'khi Pass.<ref name="Journal9" /> During the first campaigns of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Sheris fell within the territory controlled by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], with the [[Tenth Army|Tenth Sector Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] being tasked with engaging the Confederacy [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] in the world's vicinity.<ref name="EGTW" />

As part of the [[Ciutric Offensive]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Reconquest of the Rim]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]] prevailed over a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] in an [[engagement at Sheris]] as well as at<ref name="EGTW" /> the planets<ref name="CSWE Fenion">{{CSWECite|I|262|Fenion}}</ref><ref name="CSWE Phindar">{{CSWECite|III|23|Phindar}}</ref> [[Engagement at Fenion|Fenion]] and [[Engagement at Phindar|Phindar]]. Those victories drove the Empire's opponents from the Salin Corridor, and by [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], Sheris was situated within [[Imperial Space]].<ref name="EGTW" />

===Battleground===
[[File:Sheris-TEA.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Sheris was the site of a battle during Grand Admiral Thrawn's campaign.]]
In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], during Imperial [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] Galactic Civil War [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Sheris was located in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] either conquered by or allied with [[Thrawn's confederation]].<ref name="TEA" /> At one point, the New Republic learned of the Imperials' intention to attack Sheris, allowing for New Republic [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|forces]] to land on the planet shortly before their enemy's arrival in the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. In order to land a force that could blitz Sheris' primary continent, the Imperials first needed to seize the Marter An [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. To do so, they first dropped on the other side of a mountain ridge from Marter An a vanguard force under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[295.902/V8]] and consisting of an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] and a pair of [[Imperial-class repulsortank|repulsortanks]]. The force then advanced toward the ridge's Bhir'khi Pass in order to destroy [[Shield Generator Station 3]] of Marter An's [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]].<ref name="Journal9" />

In response, with the local [[Planetary Security Forces|planetary defense force]] having yet to be mobilized, the New Republic dispatched a group of [[Combat Assault Vehicle]]s led by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rone Mothin]] to the pass in order to [[Stand at Bhir'khi Pass|halt]] the Imperial advance.<ref name="Journal9" /> Imperial forces later advanced to the nearby<ref name="TEA" /> planet [[Hettsk]], where they and the New Republic fought a large-scale [[Space warfare/Legends|space]] and [[Ground warfare/Legends|ground]] [[Battle of Hettsk|battle]].<ref name="HttE">{{WEGCite|story=Commando Mission|book=Heir to the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>

==Locations==
The mountain city Marter An was a major spaceport on Sheris. Shield Generator Station 3 of its deflector shield was situated outside the city. Bhir'khi Pass, which ran through a ridge near Marter An, served as an access point to the city. The pass featured a valley with a small but deep [[Water/Legends|lake]] at its center that was fed by several small mountain streams.<ref name="Journal9" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sheris first appeared in "[[Stand at Bhir'khi Pass (article)|Stand at Bhir'khi Pass]]," a ''[[Star Wars Miniatures Battles]]'' scenario written by [[Timothy S. O'Brien|Timothy O'Brien]] and published in the [[February]] [[1996]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 9|ninth issue]] of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine.<ref name="Journal9" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Sheris system, and therefore the planet itself, in grid square O-6.<ref name="TEA" />
